hook: Stock a pond. Change one thing. Watch the seasons carry it through a food web.
outcome: Explore matter cycling, energy flow, trophic cascades and inherited shade in a deterministic ecosystem tank.
sources: Curio Class Living Pond specification, git 018ace9b: original illustrative model parameters and starting pools, not a measured dataset. Model documentation and owner-authored content CC BY 4.0 under LICENSE-CONTENT.md; code MIT under LICENSE, copyright 2026 LochLogic (Curio Class).
